title: Renewed-Term Multiplier on Residential Electricity Supply Loyalty Credits
content:
**Rule.** On a Residential Electricity Supply renewal, the renewed term is counted in months from the new term's start date through its contract end date, the end month included. For a renewed term of 24 months or more the plan loyalty credit is multiplied by the long renewed-term factor of 1.2, for 12 to 23 months by the mid renewed-term factor of 1.1, and for a shorter term it is taken as it stands.

**Counting the renewed term.** The new term's start date is the agreement's latest renewal or plan change date; the end is its contract end date. The renewed term is the whole months between the two dates plus one for the end month.

| New term starts (hypothetical) | Contract end date | Whole months between | Renewed term | Plan loyalty credit is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-01 | 2028-04-30 | 23 | 24 | multiplied by 1.2 |
| 2026-05-01 | 2027-04-30 | 11 | 12 | multiplied by 1.1 |
| 2026-05-01 | 2026-10-31 | 5 | 6 | taken as it stands |

**Boundaries.** A renewed term of 24 months takes 1.2 and one of 23 months takes 1.1; 12 months takes 1.1 and 11 months is taken as it stands.

**Example (hypothetical).** A plan loyalty credit of 50.00 USD on a 24-month renewed term becomes 60.00 USD.
